audit.whatIsWrong: The two sources of truth for the level chart disagree and I could not resolve it without inventing power shifts, so I left the chart untouched and flagged it.
audit.why: Both layers here already agree with each other and with every whys[] string: Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Skill, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere. The packet chart says Tryndamere, Skill, Tryndamere, Shen, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere. The shen__tryndamere mirror says Tryndamere, Skill, Shen, Skill, Shen, Shen, Tryndamere — which would hand Shen level 6 and first item, contradicting Undying Rage at 120s and a 51.53% win rate over 1405 games.
audit.corrected: No chart edit proposed. See questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on either side's spikes.
audit.why: Twilight Assault 8/7.25/6.5/5.75/5 at 400 range; Spirit's Refuge 16/14.5/13/11.5/10; Shadow Dash 18/16/14/12/10 at 600; Stand United 200/180/160 and global; Undying Rage 120/100/80. Shen's lane power is the Q-W pattern with Ki Barrier on top; his real map spike is the 200s Stand United, not an item.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit's Refuge is described as generic damage to 'heal through', and Twilight Assault's slow is described as if it were unconditional. Both hide the actual counterplay.
audit.why: Riot's Spirit's Refuge text: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — basic attacks only, which is exactly what Tryndamere's whole pattern is, while Spinning Slash and Mocking Shout still land. Riot's Twilight Assault text: collided enemies 'are slowed while running away from Shen', so walking toward him removes the slow entirely. Mirror of your own Mocking Shout condition.
audit.corrected: Both conditions stated: step out of the blade before swinging; walk into him, never away.

audit.why: Stand United is flagged 'channel — interruptible', and the existing late/spikes[3] text already tells you to punish the channel. Left as is.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 600 range, 18s at rank 1 — sidestep it, then commit.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shadow Dash: 18s at rank 1, 600 range — his only engage, so sidestep it and he has nothing. - Spirit's Refuge blocks autos on a 16s cooldown, never your Spinning Slash. - Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — Crit him down.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only — your Spinning Slash and Mocking Shout land through it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge eats every auto near his blade — step out, then crit.

edits.before: That is Shen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Twilight Assault only slows you while you run away — walk into him, not out.

edits.before: Once your Q is up you out-trade Shen hard: his Twilight Assault (Q) sword only shreds when it catches you, so bait it, walk out of the blade, then all-in when it's on cooldown and heal the return damage off minions.
edits.after: Once your Q is up you out-trade Shen: Twilight Assault (Q) is 400 range on 8s and its slow only bites while you run away, so bait the blade, walk toward him rather than out, then all-in while it is down.

edits.before: From level 3 you own the duel: bait Twilight Assault (Q), sidestep or wait it out, then all-in when it's down and heal through his Spirit's Refuge with Bloodlust. Level 6 you get Undying Rage, which hard-invalidates any window Shen picks — he simply can't kill you, and you keep hitting.
edits.after: From level 3 you own the duel: bait Twilight Assault (Q), walk toward him so its slow never bites, then all-in while it is down. Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only, so step out of the blade before you swing. Level 6 Undying Rage is 120s at rank 1 — spend it on a kill, not on chip.
